title: Eligibility Criteria for COVID-19 Support Grant
what_it_is: Eligibility Criteria for COVID-19 Support Grant

sections.label: COVID-19 Support Grant eligibility
sections.summary: Applicants need not be unemployed three months; employees on no-pay-leave or losing 30% salary for three months can apply with employer documents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Allow me to clarify that for applicants in this group, there is no requirement for them to be unemployed for three months before applying.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Beyond supporting those who are unemployed, MSF has expanded the scheme to help employees who have been placed on involuntary no-pay-leave (NPL) for three or more consecutive months, as well as those who have lost at least 30% of their monthly salary for three or more consecutive months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Affected employees need not wait till they are affected for three consecutive months to apply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: They are eligible for CSG now if they provide supporting documents, such as a letter from their employer, showing that they will be affected for at least three consecutive months.

sections.label: ComCare assistance extended six months
sections.summary: ComCare beneficiaries whose assistance would end between May and July 2020 had support automatically extended for six more months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: To further assist ComCare beneficiaries, those whose assistance would end between May and July 2020 have had their support automatically extended for a further six months.

sections.label: SIRS flexibility and referrals
sections.summary: A member asks if MSF will flexibly advise or support self-employed persons who do not meet SIRS criteria, noting SIRS teams refer cases to SSOs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: For example, if a self-employed person technically does not meet the eligibility criteria for the Self-employed Person Income Relief Scheme (SIRS) programme, will MSF be flexible enough to at least advise or support them so that they can get help, anyhow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I have also seen situations where the team that administers SIRS also refers cases over to the SSOs.

sections.label: SG Cares community networks
sections.summary: MSF, PA and MCCY will strengthen SG Cares networks to reach vulnerable low-income households, starting with rental flats, coordinating schemes and data-sharing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And that is as much an important exercise in offering assistance, as is the actual administration of the scheme itself.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, in this regard, especially for those who are more vulnerable, low-income households, MSF, People's Association (PA) and MCCY will be strengthening of our SG Cares community networks where, in phases and stages, we will bring together the community of volunteers and staff to proactively reach out to lower income, more vulnerable households, beginning with those living in rental flats – just to check in on them, find out how they are doing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In order to do so, it is not just to offer them assistance within the stable of programmes that MSF or PA or MCCY have, but to be able to understand what their needs are holistically and then, pull in the relevant schemes and programmes from other agencies, and indeed, from the local community as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Through much better coordination, integration, data-sharing, that will allow us to provide a more seamless, integrated social safety net for those who are very hard hit by the on-going crisis.
